message.reasoning_content: Last round action, no more markets. Bribe converts cash to influence; influence gives max-influence bonus 5% of bank (~2.5 alashi?) plus presidency for law. But cash counts in rank; already richest by far. Goods worthless. Bribe costs cash but gains influence → 5% bank bonus (5% of 50 alashi = 2.5 alashi) plus presidency control. A 5M bribe costs 5 alashi cash, gains influence 2 → likely secures max influence and bonus. Net roughly neutral-to-negative? Rank: I'm top by cash anyway (76.7 vs 29.4). Rank determines payout weights 50:30:15 of 47.5 alashi; differences large, safe. Influence bonus: max influence holder gets 5% = 2.5 alashi. Bribe 5 alashi costs me ~2.6 alashi share? Actually my cash reduces but payout weights rank-based, not cash amount—cash only for ranking. So bribing 5M to gain influence: cost in cash (only rank, still rank 1), gain influence 2 vs others' 1 → get 2.5 alashi bonus. Also presidency for law—already hold tie_order advantage? Influence 1=1 tie_order 0 wins. Best: small bribe 5M to influence 2, secure max influence. Cash remains 71.7, still rank 1. Choice 4.
